verdict.rationale: The getting-started docs say findings can be routed to webhooks alongside Slack, Jira, and email, and the site mentions configurable alerts "across the platform of your choosing." These appear to be TruffleHog Enterprise notification features, and each is only a one-line mention. The custom-detector verification webhook is an outbound verification call, not an event subscription, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented webhook setup, event types and payload schema, signing/auth and retry semantics, clarity on whether open source supports it, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
